programs.title: Dynasties II
programs.desc: The authors present the fate of wild animals that, living in often difficult conditions, persistently fight for the survival of their families.Each episode concerns a representative of a different species and members of its herd.Viewers will learn, among others:the story of the eight-year-old cheetah Kali, a resident of the grassy plains in western Zambia.Despite her relatively old age, the female desperately protects her family, teaching her daughters to be independent.A resident of Kenya, an inexperienced elephant, tries to secure the existence of her twins and unite the herd after the death of the leader.A puma from Patagonia takes care of four cubs alone.The program also features croquets, whose females are fighting an internal fight for dominance, as well as a young meerkat queen and Mac the macaque, trying to maintain his dominant role in the herd and father an offspring, thus initiating his own monkey dynasty.

programs.title: New Zealand by Train
programs.desc:
There are three railway routes in New Zealand.The first of these, Northern Explorer, stretches across the North Island, from Auckland to Wellington.Coastal Pacific runs from Picton to Christchurch, offering breathtaking views from the east coast of the South Island.The "TranzAlpine" route leads from Christchurch to the wild west coast.The total length of railway lines is 4,000 km.Their construction was extremely demanding and difficult.New Zealand, being a small island country, is characterized by a huge variety of terrain.Here you can find subtropical and rainforests, mountains, oceans, volcanoes and plains with railway tracks running through them.Each episode will discuss the engineering difficulties encountered during the construction of the railway network and present places worth seeing.Local residents talk about the everyday challenges that life in this area poses for them
The director of the "Lord of the Rings" trilogy, Peter Jackson, chose New Zealand as the setting for the adventures of the hobbit and his company.It is famous for its picturesque landscapes that are the perfect background for fantastic, out-of-this-world stories.They are extremely diverse - peaceful river valleys and green hills contrast with numerous volcanoes.However, such terrain constitutes a huge challenge for the engineers responsible for the construction of the railway.Viewers will learn about the attractions of the Kiwi country from the perspective of train passengers following three routes - Northern Explorer, Coastal Pacific and TranzAlpine.The Hobbit's Land The journey is divided into two stages.The first one goes through the North Island, where the capital Wellington and Auckland - the country's largest city - are located.There is no shortage of untouched areas that viewers of "The Lord of the Rings" could see.For example, the Ngauruhoe volcano located here played the role of Mount Doom.The Northern Explorer route is 681 km long.It runs via numerous viaducts from Auckland to Wellington.Passengers travel through, among others:farmland, the engineering masterpiece of the Raurimu Spiral and the volcanic plateau.The creators of the documentary combine phenomenal landscapes with a story about the culture and history of the end of the world.

programs.title: Gordon Buchanan: My Epic Camel Adventure
programs.desc: Scottish filmmaker and TV presenter Gordon Buchanan begins his expedition through the Gobi Desert.He decides to do it on a camel, a traditional Mongolian means of transport.An animal adapted to living in a dry and hot climate will help it survive in the wilderness, rocky plains, desert dunes and the dangerous Bumbat Mountain.Gordon wants to get to know his animal companions better.It provides them with food and benefits from the warmth of their fur.He also benefits from the hospitality of nomads who live a wandering lifestyle.The journey helps him understand that climate change has direct consequences not only for animals, but also for people who inhabit the vast steppes.
